name: Invocation of Doom, Mass
body:
School necromancy [emotion, fear, mind-affecting]; Level antipaladin 4, cleric/oracle 5, inquisitor 5, lathspell 4, shaman 5
Targets one or more creatures, no two of which can be more than 30 ft. apart.

DESCRIPTION

This spell functions as invocation of doom, except it affects multiple creatures.
